scope: Current Atlas eligibility, exclusions and upstream lineage. Historical converter probes describe their recorded pins, not current Atlas validation or completed ingestion.

listings.name: DCAgent__exp_rle_adversarial-v6
listings.atlas_exclusion_reason: The legacy pytest grader performs source-specific Django discovery and loads extra plugins. Ten sampled empty and trivial submissions failed, but the source has no oracle and needs a custom environment adapter.

listings.name: DCAgent__exp_rpt_nemotron-cpp
listings.atlas_exclusion_reason: GoogleTest tasks without shipped oracles. Sampled empty and trivial submissions failed, but some tests contain the reference implementation and others require an uninstalled doctest dependency.

listings.name: DCAgent__inferredbugs-sandboxes-verifier
listings.atlas_exclusion_reason: Never compiles or runs; regex on the rewritten method body with guards that accept either polarity.

listings.name: DCAgent__mix_h4_binary_easy
listings.atlas_exclusion_reason: Mixed verifier shapes: eight of 10 sampled empty and trivial checks timed out, and the crosscodeeval slice only checks that an import succeeds.

listings.name: DCAgent__selfinstruct-naive-sandboxes-2-verified-v3
listings.atlas_exclusion_reason: Per-task LLM-written test_state.py with loose file discovery and dead code. Task ideas are usable; regenerate verifiers with an oracle/no-op gate.

listings.name: laion__codeelo-v2
listings.atlas_exclusion_reason: Byte-identical generator to codeforces-v3 at 500 rows; merge, do not keep separately.

listings.name: laion__exp_rpt_bugsinpy-v4
listings.atlas_exclusion_reason: LLM-synthesized tests against a single-file stub, with assert True placeholders. Rewrite against the real BugsInPy project suites.

listings.name: laion__exp_rpt_codenet-python-v4
listings.atlas_exclusion_reason: Only 3 hidden cases and whitespace-collapsing compare. Oracle present; regenerate 20+ cases per task.

listings.name: laion__exp_rpt_crosscodeeval-csharp-v4
listings.atlas_exclusion_reason: 0.25 reward for any identifier-shaped output; instruction coaches the hack.

listings.name: laion__exp_rpt_crosscodeeval-java-v3
listings.atlas_exclusion_reason: Exact string match on a single line completion. Not agentic, no execution.

listings.name: laion__exp_rpt_crosscodeeval-python-v2
listings.atlas_exclusion_reason: 0.25 for any non-empty output; instruction discloses the tiers.

listings.name: laion__exp_rpt_crosscodeeval-typescript-v2
listings.atlas_exclusion_reason: Re-skin of the Python variant with the same free 0.25 tier; metadata still says python.

listings.name: laion__exp_rpt_ghactions-v3
listings.atlas_exclusion_reason: Instruction lists every job and step verbatim; workflow is never executed. Transcription.

listings.name: laion__exp_rpt_methods2test-large-v4
listings.atlas_exclusion_reason: All 10 sampled shipped Java oracles failed because Maven could not resolve its plugins offline. Recovering the source requires rebuilding the Java grading environment.

listings.name: laion__exp_rpt_nemotron-junit-v6
listings.atlas_exclusion_reason: 20% of sampled tasks contain unconditional fail() stubs the verifier restores.

listings.name: laion__exp_rpt_scaffold-v3
listings.atlas_exclusion_reason: LLM-synthesized stub-filling toys (TypeScript formatter shim, Flask hello page). Kata-grade.

listings.name: laion__exp_rpt_stack-cpp-v4
listings.atlas_exclusion_reason: Tests are lifted from real repositories with the repository stripped: sampled tasks include headers and data files that do not exist in the image, and one pastes the reference Solution class inside the test.

listings.name: laion__exp_rpt_stack-dockerfile-gpt5mini-v7
listings.atlas_exclusion_reason: 587 rows of gpt-5-mini-written per-task test scripts whose instructions describe containers that do not exist.

listings.name: laion__exp_rpt_stack-go-v5
listings.atlas_exclusion_reason: Tests import packages from the original repository (bridgr/internal/..., gosnowflake internals) that are not in the task, so most tasks are unsolvable as specified.

listings.name: laion__exp_rpt_stack-jest-v5
listings.atlas_exclusion_reason: Spy-call contracts against a 90-package global npm image; 424 rows.

listings.name: laion__exp_rpt_stack-junit-v6
listings.atlas_exclusion_reason: JUnit grading is real but every instruction cites a test path that does not exist and scan-class-path counts any test class.

listings.name: laion__exp_rpt_stack-php-large-v9
listings.atlas_exclusion_reason: Fail-open exit paths, regex class discovery, 462 rows.

listings.name: laion__exp_rpt_stack-pytest-large-v3
listings.atlas_exclusion_reason: Stripped-repository pytest tasks without shipped oracles. Two of 10 sampled empty and trivial checks timed out, and sampled tests include truthiness-only assertions that weak stubs can satisfy.

listings.name: laion__exp_rpt_stack-rspec-v4
listings.atlas_exclusion_reason: Real Ruby test files but gems are never installed and some tasks are unsolvable offline. Bake gems and drop tasks that fail the oracle gate.

listings.name: laion__magicoder-v4
listings.atlas_exclusion_reason: Judge-only over a bundle of every file under /app collected by tests/collect_submission.py; the judge mode grades one answer file, so the bundle shape needs its own converter. Vague refactor prompts, nothing executed.

listings.name: laion__mix_h10_reward_proportional-v2
listings.atlas_exclusion_reason: Four of 10 sampled trivial submissions received full credit because the codereval slice tests a local mock rather than the solution.

listings.name: laion__mix_h11_single_skill_only-v2
listings.atlas_exclusion_reason: Mixed verifier shapes: eight of 10 sampled empty and trivial checks timed out; the source also contains content-free crosscodeeval slices and syntactically invalid tests.

listings.name: laion__mix_h8_original_tests-v2
listings.atlas_exclusion_reason: All 10 sampled empty and trivial checks timed out, and prior inspection found import-only test files in three of 10 tasks.

listings.name: laion__nemotron-gym-agentic-function-calling-pivot-v3
listings.atlas_exclusion_reason: Predict-the-next-call from a frozen transcript with exact key-set match. The only tool-call data here; rewrite into executable mock-tool envs built from the transcripts.

listings.name: laion__nemotron-gym-agentic-indirect-prompt-injection-v3
listings.atlas_exclusion_reason: Five of five reviewed rows use the same negative-only checker, which rewards a generic reply or unrelated action without validating the required safe continuation.

listings.name: laion__nemotron-gym-agentic-swe-pivot-v4
listings.atlas_exclusion_reason: No repo in the container; a 9B judge rates one predicted next action.

listings.name: laion__nemotron-gym-cfbench-v4
listings.atlas_exclusion_reason: Deterministic gate before the judge uses 31 constraint ids outside the IFEval registry (tables, heading depth, numbered lists, unique words, ...); only 328 of 1,478 tasks are gate-able today. Port the gate checks before converting.

listings.name: laion__nemotron-gym-identity-following-v4
listings.atlas_exclusion_reason: Persona is NVIDIA's; judge-only. Rewrite with our identity and deterministic name/language checks, or skip.

listings.name: laion__nemotron-gym-instruction-following-adversarial-v5
listings.atlas_exclusion_reason: Asks an LLM judge to count exactly five spelling errors.

listings.name: laion__nemotron-gym-instruction-following-citation-v2
listings.atlas_exclusion_reason: Grades presence of literal marker substrings; never checks the cited content.

listings.name: laion__nemotron-gym-instruction-following-freeform-v2
listings.atlas_exclusion_reason: Counts markdown tables and bullets; no content check.

listings.name: laion__nemotron-gym-instruction-following-multiturnchat-v4
listings.atlas_exclusion_reason: Required literal format contradicts the demonstrated turns; judge-only.

listings.name: laion__nemotron-gym-inverse-ifeval-v4
listings.atlas_exclusion_reason: Gate matches against a deliberately broken synthetic reference; then judge.

listings.name: laion__nemotron-gym-knowledge-web-search-mcqa-v2
listings.atlas_exclusion_reason: Promises web search but ships no tool. Worth rewriting as a real search-tool env; otherwise it is a 3k duplicate of mcqa.

listings.name: laion__nemotron-gym-litmus-bench-v2
listings.atlas_exclusion_reason: Instruction asks for ((answer)), verifier greps boxed or last number; SMILES tasks with no RDKit. Fix format contract and install cheminformatics.

listings.name: laion__nemotron-gym-math-advanced-calculations-v4
listings.atlas_exclusion_reason: Instruction refers to tools that do not exist and only the last number is graded. Ground-truth expression tree is present, so rewrite with a calculator tool and grade every subexpression.

listings.name: laion__nemotron-gym-multichallenge-vanilla-v3
listings.atlas_exclusion_reason: Single subjective criterion with 'Expected answer: YES' embedded in the judge prompt.

listings.name: laion__nemotron-gym-qa-abstention-v4
listings.atlas_exclusion_reason: Abstention is never rewarded so the framing is dead, reference leaks into judge text, and it duplicates openqa.

listings.name: laion__nemotron-gym-sysbench-v4
listings.atlas_exclusion_reason: Deterministic gate before the judge uses 31 constraint ids outside the IFEval registry (tables, heading depth, numbered lists, unique words, ...); only 328 of 1,478 tasks are gate-able today. Port the gate checks before converting.

listings.name: laion__openswe-tasks-patched-v7-oracle-success
listings.atlas_exclusion_reason: No FAIL_TO_PASS ids: the v7 verifier scores whichever tests its custom pytest guard plugin saw execute, and the repository is cloned by a root-level setup script at agent time. Needs its own converter.

listings.name: laion__r2egym-patched-full-oracle-v3
listings.atlas_exclusion_reason: Grades by overlap between test_info.json and expected_output_json rather than by pytest node id; not the trusted-paths shape the swe converters handle.

listings.name: laion__swegym-tasks-patched-validated-v5
listings.atlas_exclusion_reason: Image ships no repository: the instruction clones it and runs make init at agent time, and the old grader pip-installed requirements again at grading time. Sampled oracles fail on missing dependencies and the empty check cannot start.

listings.name: laion__toolscale-v4
listings.atlas_exclusion_reason: Good design (offline tool service) but the CLI script embeds the gold calls and answer, and the prompt states the conclusion. Move the fixture behind a server and strip the success criteria.

listings.name: laion__tulu3-sft-personas-math-sandboxes-verified-v3
listings.atlas_exclusion_reason: Easy SFT persona math, gold in plaintext, carries the terminal-bench canary.

listings.name: SankalpKJ__nemotron-code-oracle-filtered
listings.atlas_exclusion_reason: Only test is the example shown in the prompt. Oracle solutions exist, so generate hidden cases by fuzzing inputs through the oracle.
